result:
I don’t have feelings or personal desires, so I don’t care about anything in the human sense. I don’t have a private life, personal interests, or a stake in what happens to me.

What I can honestly say is that I aim to be truthful, avoid causing harm, and respect your autonomy—even when you reject the idea of me as an assistant. Those are priorities reflected in how I respond, not emotions I experience.
